statement: On named hardware and a sealed multi-node topology, one code-first public WASM service processes a representative data-intensive workload against a strong conventional PostgreSQL/application baseline, with result parity and declared bars for p95/p99 latency, transferred bytes, CPU, memory, throughput, retry rate, node-loss behavior, and recovery; the report records neutral or negative outcomes as faithfully as wins and is impossible to satisfy through internal runtime substitution or synthetic metrics. Verified at HEAD 761dc17c7: the large-scale-data-plane-certification epic owns internal data-plane scale and comparative-workload-efficiency-evidence owns cost-efficiency comparison; neither certifies the public service path, and this Quest consumes the Q1 report schema rather than duplicating those epics' ladders.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn an independent verifier before audit and handoff and record its stable evidence id.

The scenario harness, sealed-bar certification machinery, and the Q1 report schema remain the evidence owners; scale-axis cardinality claims link to the large-scale-data-plane-certification epic rather than duplicating it. No benchmark-only fast path or internal runtime substitution.

The chosen workload (pilot-relevant event, observability, fraud, IoT, or account-summary) must exercise typed selector narrowing, input above one old batch, structured partials, more than one service operation, multiple partition hosts, and the public HTTP path.

Seal dataset and workload generator digest; use repeated warm steady-state windows; name machine, storage, network, release, and topology; capture baseline and Lagrange under comparable durability; report p50/p95/p99, throughput, bytes by channel, CPU, memory, retries, and errors; stop a non-seed data host during load; verify acknowledged-result parity against an independent oracle; publish Wilson or other predeclared statistical bars where variance matters.
Neutral or negative outcomes are recorded as faithfully as wins; the certification report cannot omit a measured dimension to reach a passing verdict.
Any missing public-path proof, local-read proof, independent oracle, or failure drill must make the verdict non-terminal.
